entities.name: Query ABCB6-like protein
observations: 768 aa membrane ABC transporter with N-terminal multipass membrane region and C-terminal ABC nucleotide-binding domain.
Pfam domains: MTABC_N positions 6-249, ABC_membrane positions 265-538, ABC_tran positions 600-749.
Sequence has strong homology to reviewed ABCB6 proteins: 71.7% identity to Xenopus tropicalis Q08D64 and 61.1% identity to human Q9NP58, with full query coverage and E-value 0.
Predicted function is ATP-dependent transport of porphyrins, including heme/protoporphyrin IX and coproporphyrin III; exact substrate spectrum remains context-dependent.
Candidate transport reaction: porphyrin or heme substrate(in) + ATP + H2O -> substrate(out) + ADP + phosphate + H(+).
Likely operates as a homodimeric ABC transporter in intracellular and plasma/endosomal membranes; localization is inferred from homolog annotations, not directly measured for this sequence.
Sequence-derived properties: length 768 aa, molecular weight approximately 87.3 kDa, theoretical pI 7.09.

entities.name: Human ABCB6
observations: Reviewed UniProt homolog Q9NP58; ATP-dependent transporter of a broad spectrum of porphyrins.
Annotated EC 7.6.2.5 and GO:0015439, ABC-type heme transporter activity.

Candidate substrates include heme b, protoporphyrin IX, coproporphyrin III, coproporphyrinogen III, and pheophorbide a; these are alternative database-mapped reactions rather than proof of equal specificity.
Reported localization includes plasma membrane, endoplasmic-reticulum, Golgi, endosomal/lysosomal membranes, mitochondrial outer membrane, and melanosome membrane.
Annotated as a homodimer; ATPase activity is modulated by porphyrins, hemin, glutathione, and copper in reported assays.

entities.name: Porphyrin ABC export
observations: Best-supported reaction class: ATP hydrolysis drives transmembrane export or import of porphyrin-family substrates.
General stoichiometry: porphyrin(in) + ATP + H2O -> porphyrin(out) + ADP + phosphate + H(+).
Rhea-linked examples include heme b (RHEA:19261), protoporphyrin IX (RHEA:61336), coproporphyrin III (RHEA:66664), and pheophorbide a (RHEA:61360).
